gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — DDAY-B7-X01 CORRECTION (NO SYNTHESIZED STATE EVENTS + FAIL-CLOSED QOS-1 ACK)
objective: Bounded C02 of DDAY-B7-X01 only: (1) remove synthesized MACHINE_STATE_CHANGED events from snapshot/current-state projection so state events originate only from real runtime event records; (2) make QoS-1 ACK handling fail closed so unacknowledged, timed-out, or negative-rc publishes are never counted as delivered. Keep dday-bw-b1-v2, EVENT_ONLY/NON_MEASUREMENT metadata for the three operating_state entries, zero signal/.../operating_state, all six event types, deterministic timestamps, and unchanged topology/route/scenarios.

conservative_interpretation.issue_115_live_read: Live Issue #115 could not be fetched (GitHub App token still lacks issues:read; GraphQL unresolved). The user pasted the complete SA C02 order in chat. Combined with SA PR #101 comment 5987569082 (CORRECTION REQUIRED at 97e313a), C02 must fix the two named blockers only.
conservative_interpretation.blocker_1: Stop calling map_event_only_state from map_snapshot. Keep the three operating_state dictionary rows as EVENT_ONLY / NON_MEASUREMENT metadata. Outbound MACHINE_STATE_CHANGED must come only from snapshot.recent_events via the existing selected-event mapper. Two identical/no-transition snapshots must add zero state events. One real runtime transition must produce exactly one mapped state event.
conservative_interpretation.blocker_2: publish_raw and publish_via_existing_mqtt must treat QoS-1 success only after confirmed ACK and rc==0. ACK timeout, missing ACK API, and negative rc raise a deterministic failure and must not increment the delivered count. Drain/disconnect must report an undelivered tail as failure. Waiting stays bounded. No retry/persistence framework.
conservative_interpretation.keep: Do not revert dday-bw-b1-v2. Do not put operating_state back on signal topics. Do not change Capper/Compressor helpers, overview, topology, route, or timestamp semantics.
